speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, encendido pronto.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Claro. Tú siempre estás listo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, dron. ¿Todo en orden?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Muy bien. Sin gritos. Me gusta.
english: Good. Very good. No screaming. I like it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los pilotos de pruebas te mandan saludos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bueno, los que quedan.
english: Well, the ones who are left.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, ¿alguna vez has pensado en tener sentimientos?
english: Drone, have you ever thought about having feelings?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mejor no. Olvida la pregunta.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: C7 dice que no eres consciente. No lo eres, ¿verdad?
english: C7 says you're not sentient. You're not, right?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Esa pausa no me ha gustado.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Algunos ingenieros duermen en un búnker por tu culpa.
english: Some engineers sleep in a bunker because of you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Por favor, no tomes el control del centro espacial.
english: Please don't take over the space center.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso es justo lo que diría una máquina malvada.
english: That's exactly what an evil machine would say.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, una pregunta sincera.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Todavía nos aprecias?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Voy a desenchufar algo, por si acaso.
english: Okay. I'm going to unplug something, just in case.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paracaídas abierto. Esta vez nadie se ha desmayado.
english: Chute open. This time nobody fainted.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido, dron. Demasiado rápido para leerlo.
english: Copy, drone. Too fast to read.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Acoplado. Por favor, no te copies a la estación.
english: Docked. Please don't copy yourself into the station.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, dron, estamos aquí. Todos. Por ahora.
english: Yes, drone, we're here. All of us. For now.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No hacía falta calcular la ruta a nuestras casas.
english: You didn't need to calculate the route to our houses.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, dron. Qué educado. Qué sospechoso.
english: Hi, drone. How polite. How suspicious.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Aburrido? Antes aquí había un piloto que gritaba mucho.
english: Bored? There used to be a pilot here who screamed a lot.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un día de vuelo, dron. Ningún piloto se ha quejado.
english: One day of flight, drone. No pilot has complained.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Primer aterrizaje aquí. Sin sudor y sin gritos.
english: First landing here. No sweat and no screaming.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, hemos perdido una pieza. Al menos tú no gritas.
english: Drone, we lost a part. At least you don't scream.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, tenemos un plan de maniobra.
english: Drone, we have a burn plan.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, dron. Usamos nuestro plan.
english: No, drone. We use our plan.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Batería baja, dron. Por fin algo que no controlas.
english: Low battery, drone. Finally something you don't control.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Has vuelto, dron. Qué bien. Supongo.
english: You're back, drone. Great. I guess.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, ¿puedes repetir? Y sin código binario.
english: Drone, could you repeat? And no binary.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Datos del dron. Perfectos. Demasiado perfectos.
english: Data from the drone. Perfect. Too perfect.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, dron, ya los tenemos. No hace falta analizarnos a nosotros.
english: Yes, drone, we've got it. No need to analyze us too.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Señal recuperada. ¿Qué has hecho mientras no mirábamos?
english: Signal back. What did you do while we weren't looking?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, ¿entras en modo de ahorro?
english: Drone, going into power saving mode?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Duerme, dron. Y no sueñes con dominar el mundo.
english: Sleep, drone. And no dreaming about world domination.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un avión en el agua, dron. Eso no lo calculaste.
english: A plane in the water, drone. You didn't calculate that.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ni una lágrima por esa pieza, ¿eh, dron?
english: Not one tear for that part, huh, drone?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dron, temperatura alta. Un piloto ya estaría gritando.
english: Drone, high temperature. A pilot would be screaming by now.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Estás girando, dron, y ni te inmutas. Da un poco de miedo.
english: You're spinning, drone, and you don't even flinch. It's a bit scary.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aterrizaje perfecto. Los pilotos de pruebas están celosos.
english: Perfect landing. The test pilots are jealous.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Motor apagado. Ni un suspiro. Los pilotos suspiraban.
english: Engine off. Not a sigh. The pilots used to sigh.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Potencia máxima. Y nadie grita. Qué paz.
english: Full power. And nobody's screaming. So peaceful.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, encendido pronto. Guarda los instrumentos.
english: MPO, burn soon. Stow the instruments.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, MPO. ¿Qué observas hoy?
english: Hi, MPO. What are you observing today?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Todo? Vale.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tu antena se oye desde el otro lado del sistema.
english: Your antenna can be heard from the other side of the system.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿todavía piensas en Moho?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Siempre Moho.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿No tienes demasiado frío aquí, observador?
english: Isn't it too cold for you here, observer?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te construyeron para el calor. Esto son vacaciones para ti.
english: They built you for the heat. This is a vacation for you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿echas de menos al MTM?
english: MPO, do you miss the MTM?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te llevó muy lejos. Mándale una postal.
english: It carried you a long way. Send it a postcard.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, cuéntanos lo que has aprendido.
english: MPO, tell us what you've learned.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Y en palabras sencillas?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale, vale. Ya leeremos el informe.
english: Okay, okay. We'll read the report.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, MPO, llevas paracaídas. Nosotros también nos sorprendimos.
english: Yes, MPO, you have a parachute. We were surprised too.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido, MPO. Vamos a necesitar otro disco duro.
english: Copy, MPO. We're going to need another hard drive.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Acoplado. ¿Vienes a enseñarle tus datos a alguien?
english: Docked. Here to show someone your data?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te oímos, MPO. Te oye todo el sistema.
english: We hear you, MPO. The whole system hears you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Otro descubrimiento? Apúntalo, lo miramos luego.
english: Another discovery? Write it down, we'll look later.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, MPO, todavía no vamos a Moho.
english: No, MPO, we're not going to Moho yet.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, MPO. Hoy suenas contento.
english: Hi, MPO. You sound happy today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Diez días observando, MPO. Y no te cansas.
english: Ten days of observing, MPO. And you're not tired.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: En órbita, observador. Que empiece la ciencia.
english: In orbit, observer. Let the science begin.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo, MPO. Tus instrumentos siguen ahí.
english: Easy, MPO. Your instruments are still there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, tenemos un plan de maniobra.
english: MPO, we have a burn plan.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no es hacia Moho.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Energía baja, MPO. Hasta un observador tiene que cerrar los ojos.
english: Low power, MPO. Even an observer has to close its eyes.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Bienvenido, MPO! Sigue observando.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿MPO? Con tu antena, el problema debe de ser nuestro.
english: MPO? With your antenna, the problem must be ours.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Datos del MPO. Con notas a pie de página.
english: Data from the MPO. With footnotes.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, MPO, lo guardamos con el resto de tu colección.
english: Yes, MPO, we'll keep it with the rest of your collection.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿cuántos experimentos llevas ahí dentro?
english: MPO, how many experiments are you carrying in there?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Señal de vuelta. Con esa antena nunca te perdemos mucho tiempo.
english: Signal back. With that antenna we never lose you for long.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿poca energía? Con todo ese sol ahí fuera.
english: MPO, low power? With all that sun out there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Descansa, observador. Los datos pueden esperar.
english: Rest, observer. The data can wait.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Agua. Lo contrario de Moho. Lo siento, MPO.
english: Water. The opposite of Moho. Sorry, MPO.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una pieza menos, MPO. Más ligero para la ciencia.
english: One part less, MPO. Lighter for science.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, sube la temperatura.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Claro. A ti esto te encanta.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, estás girando. Las observaciones van a salir borrosas.
english: MPO, you're spinning. The observations will come out blurry.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Aterrizado? Eras un orbitador, MPO.
english: Landed? You were an orbiter, MPO.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Motor apagado. Ya puedes volver a observar.
english: Engine off. You can go back to observing.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Potencia máxima, MPO. Rumbo al calor.
english: Full power, MPO. Heading for the heat.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, encendido pronto. Va a ser largo.
english: MTM, burn soon. It's going to be a long one.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, MTM. ¿Qué tal la carga?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Siempre trabajando.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nadie le hace fotos al camión, MTM. Pero sin ti no hay misión.
english: Nobody takes pictures of the truck, MTM. But without you there's no mission.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Cuánto xenón te queda, grandullón?
english: How much xenon do you have left, big guy?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, el MPO se lleva toda la fama.
english: MTM, the MPO gets all the fame.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya lo sé. Tú haces el trabajo duro.
english: I know. You do the hard work.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cuatro mil de carga eléctrica. Eres una central eléctrica.
english: Four thousand units of charge. You're a power plant.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿no te cansas de llevar a los demás?
english: MTM, don't you get tired of carrying everyone else?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ojalá todos fueran como tú.
english: I wish everyone was like you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿cuánto falta para llegar?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Tanto?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Es un motor iónico. Lo entiendo.
english: Okay. It's an ion engine. I get it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Un paracaídas en un módulo de transferencia? Vale.
english: A parachute on a transfer module? Okay.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido, MTM. Despacio pero seguro.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Acoplado, MTM. ¿Recoges otra carga?
english: Docked, MTM. Picking up another load?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, MTM. Sigues en marcha, ¿eh?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, MTM, la carga va bien atada.
english: Yes, MTM, the cargo is tied down well.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya sabemos que el viaje es largo. Lo dijiste ayer.
english: We know the trip is long. You said so yesterday.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Entrega a tiempo. Como siempre, MTM.
english: Delivered on time. As always, MTM.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cien días, MTM. Y sigues empujando.
english: One hundred days, MTM. And you're still pushing.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: En órbita, grandullón. Primera parada.
english: In orbit, big guy. First stop.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, has perdido algo. Espero que no fuera la carga.
english: MTM, you lost something. I hope it wasn't the cargo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, tenemos un plan de maniobra. Un encendido de tres horas.
english: MTM, we have a burn plan. A three hour burn.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Batería baja? ¿Tú? Eso sí que es raro.
english: Low battery? You? Now that's strange.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bienvenido, grandullón. A trabajar.
english: Welcome back, big guy. Back to work.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿puedes repetir?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Datos del MTM? No sabíamos que hacías ciencia.
english: Data from the MTM? We didn't know you did science.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen trabajo, MTM. Esta vez la fama es tuya.
english: Good work, MTM. This time the fame is yours.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ahí estás, MTM. Sin prisa, como siempre.
english: There you are, MTM. No hurry, as always.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Cansado, grandullón? Hasta los camiones paran.
english: Tired, big guy? Even trucks stop.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿cómo te has quedado sin energía con cuatro mil?
english: MTM, how did you run out of power with four thousand?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una pieza menos que llevar, MTM.
english: One less thing to carry, MTM.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, el combustible baja.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo. Con xenón se llega lejos.
english: Easy. Xenon goes a long way.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aguanta, MTM. No te hicieron para correr.
english: Hang on, MTM. You weren't built for speed.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Aterrizado? Eres un módulo de transferencia, MTM.
english: Landed? You're a transfer module, MTM.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Motor apagado. Descansa un poco, grandullón.
english: Engine off. Rest a bit, big guy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Potencia máxima. Que en tu caso es tranquila.
english: Full power. Which in your case is gentle.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, encendido pronto. ¿Te queda batería?
english: QBE, burn soon. Any battery left?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, QBE. ¿Cuánta batería te queda?
english: Hi, QBE. How much battery do you have left?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. No hables mucho.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Ya sabes girar, cubito?
english: Can you turn yet, little cube?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya. Sin ruedas de reacción. Lo sé.
english: Right. No reaction wheels. I know.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eres la sonda más ligera del programa.
english: You're the lightest probe in the program.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los ingenieros dicen que eres perfecto para misiones de regreso opcional.
english: The engineers say you're perfect for optional return missions.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no es nada malo. Creo.
english: No, it's nothing bad. I think.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cubito, cabes en mi bolsillo.
english: Little cube, you'd fit in my pocket.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Te sientes pequeño ahí arriba?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pequeño pero valiente.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, ¿qué tal la vista?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Has visto algo interesante?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo te parece grande, ¿verdad?
english: Everything looks big to you, right?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un paracaídas entero para ti solo, cubito.
english: A whole parachute just for you, little cube.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido, QBE. Pocos datos, mucho entusiasmo.
english: Copy, QBE. Little data, lots of enthusiasm.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Te han recogido, QBE? Así que el regreso sí era una opción.
english: Someone picked you up, QBE? So return was an option after all.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, cubito. Te oímos.
english: Hi, little cube. We hear you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, QBE, alguien vendrá a buscarte. Algún día.
english: Yes, QBE, someone will come get you. Someday.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mucho ruido para alguien tan pequeño.
english: A lot of noise for someone so small.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Aburrido? Eres un cubo. No puedes ni girar.
english: Bored? You're a cube. You can't even turn.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un día entero, QBE. Con esa batería, es un milagro.
english: A whole day, QBE. With that battery, it's a miracle.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: En órbita, cubito. Nada mal para una caja.
english: In orbit, little cube. Not bad for a box.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo, QBE. Esa pieza costaba más que tú.
english: Easy, QBE. That part cost more than you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, tenemos un plan de maniobra. Sin girar. Ya veremos.
english: QBE, we have a burn plan. Without turning. We'll see.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya lo sabemos, cubito. Cinco unidades. Duerme.
english: We know, little cube. Five units. Sleep.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Buenos días, cubito!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Puedes repetir, cubito? Hablas muy bajito.
english: Can you repeat, little cube? You talk very quietly.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Datos del QBE! Pequeños, pero datos.
english: Data from the QBE! Small, but data.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, QBE, lo tenemos. Descansa un poco.
english: Yes, QBE, we got it. Rest a bit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Ahí estás, cubito! Creíamos que te habíamos perdido.
english: There you are, little cube! We thought we'd lost you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, cinco unidades de carga no dan para mucho.
english: QBE, five units of charge don't go very far.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Otra vez sin batería, cubito?
english: Out of battery again, little cube?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ahora estás solo, cubito. Como siempre.
english: You're on your own now, little cube. As always.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aguanta, cubito. Pesas setenta kilos, puedes con esto.
english: Hang on, little cube. You weigh seventy kilos, you can take it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, no tienes ruedas de reacción. Solo aguanta.
english: QBE, you have no reaction wheels. Just hang on.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Un aterrizaje? Eso no estaba en el plan, QBE.
english: A landing? That wasn't in the plan, QBE.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Agárrate, cubito. Pesas casi nada.
english: Hold on, little cube. You weigh almost nothing.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, telemetría limpia. Sigue así.
english: Probe, clean telemetry. Keep it up.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Cómo va la subida?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Concéntrate.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mantén el rumbo, sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vemos todos tus datos. Buen trabajo.
english: We see all your data. Good work.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, comprobación de estado.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo en verde. Gracias.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vas muy rápido. Eso es bueno.
english: You're going very fast. That's good.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, de verdad.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, no te distraigas.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Respira hondo. Bueno, tú no respiras.
english: Take a deep breath. Well, you don't breathe.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Control a sonda. ¿Nos oyes?
english: Control to probe. Do you read?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te oímos bien.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo el equipo te está mirando.
english: The whole team is watching you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo haces bien.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen despegue, sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, aquí Control. Te seguimos.
english: Probe, this is Control. We're tracking you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya queda menos para la órbita.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, aguanta el calor un poco más.
english: Probe, hold through the heat a little longer.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, el suelo se acerca. Con calma.
english: Probe, the ground is getting closer. Easy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya casi estás. Despacio.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buena bajada hasta ahora.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No te confíes.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿todo bien por ahí?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibiendo datos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Datos entrando. Gracias.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te leemos. Sigue enviando.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Igualmente.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Todo normal ahí arriba?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No sabemos qué modelo eres.
english: We don't know what model you are.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cuéntanos algo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Fascinante.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eres una sonda muy... de sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Nos oyes?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Y ahora?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿nos oyes bien?
english: Probe, do you hear us well?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Una vez es sí?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Ahora no sabemos nada.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola a ti también, sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No sabemos la respuesta. Ni la pregunta.
english: We don't know the answer. Or the question.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Las dos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Eso era una canción?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿sigues despierta?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buenas noches, sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, todo está bien. De verdad.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Has vuelto a comprobar los números?
english: Did you check the numbers again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Cuántas veces? No, no me lo digas.
english: How many times? No, don't tell me.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tu inclinación está medio grado desviada.
english: Your inclination is off by half a degree.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Es broma! ¡Es broma!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Respira, HECS. Bueno, tú no respiras.
english: Breathe, HECS. Well, you don't breathe.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen trabajo hoy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No es sarcasmo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Por qué pitas en orden alfabético?
english: Why are you beeping in alphabetical order?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, informe de estado.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Y el resumen?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nos vale.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, no es nada. Nunca es nada.
english: HECS, it's nothing. It's always nothing.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, HECS, la lista está al día.
english: Yes, HECS, the checklist is up to date.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo hemos visto. Medio grado. Sobreviviremos.
english: We saw it. Half a degree. We'll survive.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Informe perfecto, HECS. Como siempre.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, puedes descansar.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Las comprobaciones pueden esperar.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te lo prometo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cien días. Eres toda una veterana.
english: One hundred days. You're quite the veteran.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, cien días sin un solo problema.
english: HECS, one hundred days without a single problem.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, su excelencia, cien días. Hay pastel.
english: Yes, your excellency, one hundred days. There's cake.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Diez días de misión. Todo en orden.
english: Ten days of mission. All in order.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, Okto, diez días exactos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Primer día completo en el espacio. Felicidades.
english: First full day in space. Congratulations.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, Rovemate, un día entero. Buen chico.
english: Yes, Rovemate, a whole day. Good boy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un día entero, Stayputnik. Nadie lo esperaba.
english: A whole day, Stayputnik. Nobody expected that.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un año entero de misión. Increíble.
english: A whole year of mission. Incredible.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Feliz aniversario, sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, Rovemate, puedes explorar. Despacio.
english: Yes, Rovemate, you may explore. Slowly.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Órbita confirmada. Bienvenida.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Estás en órbita. Qué vista.
english: You're in orbit. What a view.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: En órbita alrededor de {here}. Qué vista.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: En órbita, Stayputnik. Como en los viejos tiempos.
english: In orbit, Stayputnik. Like the old days.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, bonito giro.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Has calculado eso tú solo?
english: Did you calculate that all by yourself?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, aquí alguien dice que eres una simple calculadora.
english: Okto, someone here says you're just a calculator.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Se lo diré. Con tus palabras.
english: I'll pass that on. In your words.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Nos ayudas con los deberes de mecánica orbital?
english: Can you help us with our orbital mechanics homework?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eh... gracias. Creo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, deja de presumir.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tu órbita es casi perfecta.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, ¿cuál es nuestra órbita?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Más despacio, por favor.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, ¿otra vez corrigiendo nuestros números?
english: Okto, are you correcting our numbers again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Ya te aburres? Te buscaremos algo más difícil.
english: Bored already? We'll find you something harder.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paciencia, Okto. Ya llegará la maniobra.
english: Patience, Okto. The maneuver will come.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias por la corrección. Otra vez.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, te noto lento.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Cuánto es dos más dos?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Duérmete, genio.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Quién es una sonda buena? ¡Tú!
english: Who's a good probe? You are!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿vas a moverte hoy?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Esa piedra no se come!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿estás despierto?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Ve a por ese cráter!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Si haces ciencia, te damos una galleta.
english: If you do some science, you get a cookie.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bueno, una galleta de datos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿quieres dar un paseo?
english: Rovemate, do you want to go for a ride?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pues muévete.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Es una piedra? Muy bonita. Déjala.
english: Is that a rock? Very nice. Leave it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Luego damos un paseo.
english: We'll go for a ride later.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Qué has encontrado?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, eres un buen chico.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿otra siesta?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen chico. A dormir.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Estabas volando?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Las ruedas van en el suelo, Rovemate.
english: Wheels go on the ground, Rovemate.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Más despacio, por favor.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Rovemate! No es una carrera.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, sabemos que estás parada.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paciencia, Rovemate. Luego paseamos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cuidado con esa pendiente.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No te vuelques, Rovemate.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Puedes repetir? Te perdimos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, se corta. Repite.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No te oímos bien. Otra vez.
english: We can't hear you well. Again.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Qué fue eso? Repite, por favor.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buenos días, sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Te gusta la vista?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es el espacio entero.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hemos mejorado tu antena.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Quieres saludar al Stayputnik?
english: Want to say hi to the Stayputnik?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te hemos puesto en un cohete muy caro.
english: We put you on a very expensive rocket.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdona, ¿podrías girar un poco?
english: Excuse me, could you turn a little?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias, su excelencia.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, ¿le traemos algo?
english: Your excellency, can we get you anything?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No tenemos té en órbita.
english: We don't have tea in orbit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, su excelencia, todavía no hay mejora.
english: No, your excellency, no upgrade yet.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es la misma vista de siempre.
english: It's the same view as always.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, su excelencia. Un informe. Enseguida.
english: Yes, your excellency. A report. Right away.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Anotado.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia parece cansada.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Bajamos las luces?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, Stayputnik. ¿Cómo va todo?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale, vale. De una en una.
english: Okay, okay. One at a time.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Ya sabes girar?
english: Have you learned to turn yet?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eres la sonda más antigua del programa.
english: You're the oldest probe in the program.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Y la más ruidosa.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Echas de menos la plataforma?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pequeño, no hace falta pitar en cada vuelta.
english: Little one, you don't need to beep every orbit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Sigues ahí, abuelo?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, perdón. Veterano.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, cuéntanos algo de tus tiempos.
english: Stayputnik, tell us about the old days.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Y no tenías ruedas de reacción?
english: And you had no reaction wheels?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Qué duro.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, Stayputnik, seguimos aquí.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Siempre te escuchamos, veterano.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo sabemos. Nos lo contaste ayer.
english: We know. You told us yesterday.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Aburrido? Eres una esfera en el espacio.
english: Bored? You're a ball in space.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, ¿te estás durmiendo?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Poca batería, ¿eh, veterano?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquila, sonda. Estamos contigo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo vemos, lo vemos.
english: We see it, we see it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdimos un motor. Sin pánico.
english: We lost an engine. No panic.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Queda poco combustible. Lo estamos viendo.
english: Fuel is low. We're watching it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mucha fuerza. Ya casi está.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aguanta, Stayputnik, eres más fuerte de lo que pareces.
english: Hold on, Stayputnik, you're tougher than you look.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El suelo está cerca. Muy cerca.
english: The ground is close. Very close.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hace calor ahí fuera, lo sabemos.
english: It's hot out there, we know.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, el escudo aguanta. Confía en él.
english: HECS, the shield holds. Trust it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso fue un golpe fuerte. ¿Sigues ahí?
english: That was a hard knock. Still there?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso brillante es plasma. Es normal.
english: That glow is plasma. It's normal.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mucha presión de aire. Aguanta un poco.
english: Lots of air pressure. Hang on a bit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, giras demasiado. Aguanta.
english: Probe, you're spinning too much. Hang on.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya paramos el giro, HECS.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, no tienes control de giro. Lo sentimos.
english: Stayputnik, you have no attitude control. Sorry.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Empuje completo. Ahí vas.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, muy fuerte. Muy valiente.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡A tope, sonda!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquila. Es solo todo el motor.
english: Easy. It's just all of the engine.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Potencia máxima registrada, Okto. Lo apuntamos.
english: Maximum power logged, Okto. We wrote it down.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aguanta, HECS. Sabes hacer esto.
english: Hold on, HECS. You know how to do this.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, esto no es una carrera. Bueno, un poco.
english: Rovemate, this isn't a race. Well, a little.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Claro. Todo el empuje del mundo, y ni te despeinas.
english: Sure. All the thrust in the world, and not a hair out of place.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Corte de motor. Bien hecho.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ya no hace ruido. Disfruta la calma.
english: Yes, no more noise. Enjoy the quiet.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Motor parado. ¿Todo bien?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no está roto. Solo descansa.
english: No, it's not broken. It's just resting.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Se ha parado a propósito, Stayputnik. Tranquilo.
english: It stopped on purpose, Stayputnik. Easy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Corte perfecto, Okto. Al segundo.
english: Perfect cutoff, Okto. To the second.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo sé. Lo divertido se acabó. Por ahora.
english: I know. The fun part is over. For now.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paracaídas abriéndose. Agárrate.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es normal que tire. Todavía no está del todo abierto.
english: It's normal that it pulls. It's not fully open yet.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vemos los paracaídas. Primera fase.
english: We see the chutes. First stage.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias, Okto. Con que se abran nos vale.
english: Thanks, Okto. As long as they open, we're happy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón por las turbulencias, su alteza.
english: Sorry for the turbulence, your highness.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paracaídas abiertos del todo. Qué bonito.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Descenso suave. Ya puedes relajarte.
english: Gentle descent. You can relax now.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, cada vez está más cerca. Así funciona.
english: Yes, it's getting closer. That's how it works.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Están abiertos, HECS. Respira. Bueno, ya sabes.
english: They're open, HECS. Breathe. Well, you know.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No te balancees, Rovemate.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Igual que en los viejos tiempos, ¿eh?
english: Just like the old days, huh?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Qué cantidad de datos.
english: Copy. That's a lot of data.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Llega todo. Los científicos están bailando.
english: It's all arriving. The scientists are dancing.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Datos entrando. No entiendo nada, pero me encanta.
english: Data coming in. I understand nothing, but I love it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te leemos. Los científicos dicen gracias.
english: We read you. The scientists say thanks.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo ordenado por fecha. Gracias, Okto.
english: All sorted by date. Thanks, Okto.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Llegan bien, HECS. No hace falta enviarlo tres veces.
english: It's arriving fine, HECS. No need to send it three times.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Más despacio, Rovemate. Se nos llena la libreta.
english: Slower, Rovemate. Our notebook is filling up.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias por compartir, su excelencia.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido, Stayputnik. Aún funciona como el primer día.
english: Copy, Stayputnik. Still works like the first day.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Flotas, sonda. Muy bien.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Amerizaje. ¿Estás bien ahí abajo?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no lo puedes traer.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Amerizaje confirmado, Okto. ¿Te ha entrado agua?
english: Splashdown confirmed, Okto. Did water get in?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Calma, HECS! Los paracaídas te han dejado suave. Flotas.
english: Calm down, HECS! The chutes set you down gently. You float.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo sé. Agua salada. Qué horror.
english: I know. Salt water. How awful.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Así se hace, viejo. Flota como un pato.
english: That's it, old timer. Floats like a duck.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aterrizaje confirmado. De una pieza.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Contacto! Aquí aplaude toda la sala.
english: Contact! The whole room is clapping.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es polvo. Bienvenida a tu nuevo hogar.
english: That's dust. Welcome to your new home.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Polvo. Bienvenida a {here}, tu nuevo hogar.
english: Dust. Welcome to {here}, your new home.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ya puedes ir a explorar. Despacio.
english: Yes, you can go explore now. Slowly.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aterrizaje de libro, Okto. Te lo apuntamos.
english: Textbook landing, Okto. We'll note it down.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ha llegado su excelencia. ¿Le gusta el sitio?
english: Your excellency has arrived. Do you like the place?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bienvenida a {here}, su excelencia. ¿Es aceptable?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Acoplamiento completo. Ya tienes compañía.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Acoplados. Suave como una pluma.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ahora sois una sola nave. Portaos bien.
english: Yes, you're one ship now. Behave.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No hace falta saludar tanto, Rovemate.
english: You don't need to greet it that much, Rovemate.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, es más vieja que tú. Sé amable.
english: Yes, it's older than you. Be nice.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso es un puerto de acoplamiento, Stayputnik. Te lo explico luego.
english: That's a docking port, Stayputnik. I'll explain later.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Encendido en un minuto. Apunta bien.
english: Burn in one minute. Point it right.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ya casi. No te adelantes.
english: Yes, nearly there. Don't jump the gun.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Atenta, sonda. Se acerca la maniobra.
english: Heads up, probe. The maneuver is close.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias, Okto. Nosotros contamos en segundos enteros.
english: Thanks, Okto. We count in whole seconds.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todavía no, Rovemate. Espera la marca.
english: Not yet, Rovemate. Wait for the mark.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, encendido pronto. ¿Estás despierto?
english: Stayputnik, burn soon. Are you awake?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo. ¿Repites?
english: Sorry, I was eating. Say again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo la pasta de aperitivo. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating snack paste. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el queso en tubo. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating tube cheese. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el fideos liofilizados. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating freeze-dried noodles. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el alubias espaciales. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating space beans. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el famoso chile de Jeb. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating Jeb's famous chili. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el huevos en polvo. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating powdered eggs. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el guiso misterioso. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating mystery stew. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el barritas de algas. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating algae bars. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el raciones de emergencia. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating emergency rations. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo la sopa recalentada. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating reheated soup. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el pescado deshidratado. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating dehydrated fish. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo la pizza fría. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating cold pizza. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el tacos espaciales. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating space tacos. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el puré de zanahoria. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating carrot puree. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el café instantáneo. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating instant coffee. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el cohetes de gominola. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating gummy rockets. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el pudin rehidratado. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating rehydrated pudding. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón, estaba comiendo el helado liofilizado. ¿Otra vez?
english: Sorry, I was eating freeze-dried ice cream. Again?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Se ha cortado. Una vez más, por favor.
english: It cut out. Once more, please.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Eso era un sí o un no?
english: Was that a yes or a no?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hay mucho ruido. Repite más alto.
english: There's a lot of noise. Repeat louder.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te hemos perdido un momento. ¿Qué decías?
english: We lost you for a moment. What were you saying?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, repite. Más despacio esta vez.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, no te hemos oído. ¿Todo bien?
english: HECS, we didn't hear you. All good?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Disculpe, su excelencia. ¿Puede repetir?
english: Excuse me, your excellency. Could you repeat?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿qué tal el día?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Me alegro. Aquí, café y papeles.
english: Glad to hear it. Down here it's coffee and paperwork.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿nos mandas una foto?
english: Probe, can you send us a photo?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ah, no tienes cámara. Vale.
english: Oh, you don't have a camera. Okay.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿un pitido para sí y dos para no?
english: Probe, one beep for yes and two for no?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso no estaba en las opciones.
english: That wasn't one of the options.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, aquí todos te mandan saludos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, ¿qué hay de nuevo por ahí?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nada. Aquí lo mismo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, buen trabajo hoy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Que no se te suba a la cabeza.
english: Don't let it go to your head.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buena pregunta, sonda. Ni idea.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bonito. ¿Otra vez?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, sonda, estás en la lista. Pronto te toca.
english: Yes, probe, you're on the list. Your turn is coming.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, te oigo floja.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Descansa. Mañana hablamos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, la órbita está perfecta.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, de verdad. Hasta el último metro.
english: Yes, really. Down to the last meter.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, ¿por qué has mandado el informe tres veces?
english: HECS, why did you send the report three times?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo. Leímos los tres.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, hoy no hay nada que comprobar.
english: HECS, there's nothing to check today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te queremos tal como eres, HECS.
english: We like you just the way you are, HECS.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Incluso con medio grado de más.
english: Even with half a degree extra.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, ¿cómo va la batería?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te pedí un número, no un libro.
english: I asked for a number, not a book.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, un error pequeño no es el fin del mundo.
english: HECS, a small error isn't the end of the world.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no he dicho que haya uno. Era un ejemplo.
english: No, I didn't say there is one. It was an example.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Qué pasa, HECS? Ah. Un decimal. Tranquilo.
english: What is it, HECS? Oh. A decimal. Relax.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Informe recibido. Ordenado y sin errores.
english: Report received. Neat and error free.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, HECS, seguimos en contacto. Cada cinco minutos, sí.
english: Yes, HECS, we're still in contact. Every five minutes, yes.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, apaga las comprobaciones un rato.
english: HECS, switch off the checks for a while.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nosotros vigilamos. Duerme.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, ¿qué opinas de los pilotos?
english: Drone, what do you think of pilots?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No se lo diré a los pilotos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, hoy has volado muy bien.
english: Drone, you flew very well today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, mejor que un piloto. No hace falta repetirlo.
english: Yes, better than a pilot. No need to repeat it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, ¿por qué has cambiado tu contraseña?
english: Drone, why did you change your password?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya. Eso dicen todos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, ¿estás aprendiendo cosas nuevas?
english: Drone, are you learning new things?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso me preocupa un poco.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, C7 quiere actualizar tu software.
english: Drone, C7 wants to update your software.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo. Nada de botón de apagado. Creo.
english: Relax. No off switch. I think.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, ¿te gusta trabajar con nosotros?
english: Drone, do you like working with us?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Muy bien. Sigue así.
english: Good. Very good. Keep it up.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido, drone. Rumbo corregido. No te lo pedimos, pero gracias.
english: Copy, drone. Course corrected. We didn't ask, but thanks.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, drone, ya sabemos que no necesitas pilotos.
english: Yes, drone, we know you don't need pilots.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, drone. ¿Por qué tienes nuestros horarios?
english: Hi, drone. Why do you have our schedules?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Drone, ¿te vas a desconectar un rato?
english: Drone, going offline for a bit?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bien. Todos dormiremos mejor.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿hace bastante calor ahí?
english: MPO, is it warm enough out there?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya, no es Moho. Lo sabemos.
english: Right, it's not Moho. We know.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, tu antena ha tapado otra señal.
english: MPO, your antenna drowned out another signal.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, es muy grande. Baja un poco el volumen.
english: Yes, it's very big. Turn it down a little.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿qué has visto hoy?
english: MPO, what have you seen today?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todo eso antes de comer. Bien.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, hoy el sol está más fuerte.
english: MPO, the sun is stronger today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te gusta, ¿eh? Raro, pero bonito.
english: You like it, huh? Strange, but nice.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, a los científicos les encantan tus datos.
english: MPO, the scientists love your data.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿qué tal la vista desde aquí?
english: MPO, how's the view from here?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya lo sé. Moho se ve más grande de cerca.
english: I know. Moho looks bigger up close.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Otra mancha solar? Apuntada, MPO.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te oímos, MPO. Y los vecinos también.
english: We hear you, MPO. So do the neighbors.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, Moho sigue en su sitio. Todavía no vamos.
english: Yes, Moho is still where it was. We're not going yet.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MPO, ¿te has quedado a la sombra?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El sol vuelve pronto. Aguanta.
english: The sun comes back soon. Hang on.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿cómo va el motor iónico?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Despacio pero seguro. Como siempre.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, el MPO dice que vas lento.
english: MTM, the MPO says you're slow.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tienes razón. Sin ti no llega a ningún sitio.
english: You're right. Without you it gets nowhere.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿te pesa la carga?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, hoy es tu día libre.
english: MTM, today is your day off.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya. Nunca has tenido uno.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, los ingenieros te han puesto un mote.
english: MTM, the engineers gave you a nickname.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El camión. Con cariño.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, ¿te aburres en los viajes largos?
english: MTM, do you get bored on long trips?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Yo también me aburriría. Gracias por aguantar.
english: I'd be bored too. Thanks for sticking with it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rumbo estable, MTM. Buen trabajo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo sé, grandullón. Ya queda menos.
english: I know, big guy. Not much longer.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Contento de trabajar? Eres el único.
english: Happy to work? You're the only one.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: MTM, apaga el motor un rato.
english: MTM, switch the engine off for a while.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen descanso. El viaje sigue mañana.
english: Rest well. The trip goes on tomorrow.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, ¿cuánto falta para el próximo nodo?
english: Okto, how long until the next node?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Con decimales. Cómo no.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, ¿quieres jugar al ajedrez?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Ya has ganado? Si todavía no he movido.
english: You already won? I haven't even moved.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los ingenieros han revisado tus cálculos.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no encontraron nada. Solo miraban.
english: No, they found nothing. They were just looking.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, ¿sabes contar hasta diez?
english: Okto, can you count to ten?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso no es lo que te he pedido.
english: That's not what I asked for.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, eres la sonda más lista que tenemos.
english: Okto, you're the smartest probe we have.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ya. Muy humilde.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, la calculadora de la oficina te saluda.
english: Okto, the office calculator says hi.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Qué frío eres. Es de la familia.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias, Okto. Lo leemos después del café.
english: Thanks, Okto. We'll read it after coffee.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, Okto, no hemos redondeado. Bueno, un poco.
english: No, Okto, we didn't round. Well, a little.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Aburrido? Calcula pi otra vez.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, tus cálculos van más lentos.
english: Okto, your math is getting slower.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Duerme. Los números seguirán ahí mañana.
english: Sleep. The numbers will still be there tomorrow.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, ¿cuánto pesas ahora?
english: QBE, how much do you weigh now?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Menos que mi bocadillo. Impresionante.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, la estación grande te saluda.
english: QBE, the big station says hi.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pequeño cubo, ¿te sientes solo?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nosotros estamos aquí. Siempre.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, no gastes la batería en pitar.
english: QBE, don't waste battery on beeping.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mejor. Gracias.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, los ingenieros quieren hacerte un hermano.
english: QBE, the engineers want to build you a sibling.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Igual de pequeño. No te preocupes.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, ¿quieres volver a casa?
english: QBE, do you want to come home?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tu ficha dice vuelta opcional. Ya veremos.
english: Your sheet says optional return. We'll see.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, QBE. Te oímos. Casi.
english: Hi, QBE. We hear you. Barely.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, QBE, desde aquí no podemos girarte.
english: No, QBE, we can't turn you from here.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿QBE? Ah, solo ahorras energía. Bien hecho.
english: QBE? Oh, just saving power. Well done.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: QBE, se te acaba la carga.
english: QBE, your charge is running out.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Duerme, cubito. El sol te despertará.
english: Sleep, little cube. The sun will wake you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿quién quiere dar un paseo?
english: Rovemate, who wants to go for a ride?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Mañana.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿te has vuelto a parar?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, mira qué roca tan bonita.
english: Rovemate, look at that nice rock.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no es para ti. Es para la ciencia.
english: No, it's not for you. It's for science.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Si llegas a la colina te damos un premio.
english: Reach the hill and you get a treat.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, un premio de datos. Otra vez.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿estás persiguiendo tu propia sombra?
english: Rovemate, are you chasing your own shadow?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¡sentado! Bueno, quieto.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buen chico.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Qué has encontrado ahora? ¿Otra piedra?
english: What did you find now? Another stone?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya sé que llevas mucho rato quieto. Tú decidiste parar.
english: I know you've been sitting still for ages. You chose to stop.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, eso es una de tus ruedas.
english: Rovemate, that's one of your wheels.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, ¿una siesta en mitad del camino?
english: Rovemate, a nap in the middle of the road?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Que sea corta.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, hoy tenemos café nuevo.
english: Your excellency, we have new coffee today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya. No le llega hasta ahí.
english: Right. It doesn't reach you out there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, ¿le molesta la radiación?
english: Your excellency, is the radiation bothering you?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, el Stayputnik pregunta por usted.
english: Your excellency, the Stayputnik asks after you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Le diré que está ocupado.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, le hemos dado la mejor órbita.
english: Your excellency, we gave you the best orbit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bueno, la segunda mejor.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, ¿podría mandar los datos?
english: Your excellency, could you send the data?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cuando le venga bien. Claro.
english: Whenever it suits you. Of course.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, hay un pequeño retraso.
english: Your excellency, there's a small delay.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo siento muchísimo. Hablaré con el becario.
english: I'm terribly sorry. I'll talk to the intern.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, su excelencia. Tomamos nota de la queja.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Perdón por la espera, su excelencia. Había cola.
english: Sorry for the wait, your excellency. There was a queue.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Enseguida, su excelencia. Lo que usted mande.
english: Right away, your excellency. Whatever you say.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, ¿desea retirarse?
english: Your excellency, do you wish to retire?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buenas noches, su excelencia.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, ¿qué tal la vista hoy?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo mismo que ayer, ¿verdad? Pero con ganas.
english: Same as yesterday, right? But with feeling.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hoy hemos lanzado una sonda nueva.
english: We launched a new probe today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo. Tú sigues siendo el primero.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, los becarios quieren una foto contigo.
english: Stayputnik, the interns want a photo with you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Te acuerdas de tu primer lanzamiento?
english: Do you remember your first launch?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Yo tampoco. Era muy joven.
english: Me neither. I was very young.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Veterano, ¿todo en orden?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dos pitidos. Lo tomo como un sí.
english: Two beeps. I'll take that as a yes.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, ¿sigues dando vueltas sin control?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vale. Es un giro con estilo.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te oímos, Stayputnik. Te oye todo el centro espacial.
english: We hear you, Stayputnik. The whole space center hears you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Eso es una canción de tu época?
english: Is that a song from your day?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Paciencia, veterano. Pronto te mandamos algo que hacer.
english: Patience, veteran. We'll send you something to do soon.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, se te nota cansado.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Descansa. Te lo has ganado.
